length.notes: Number of slots; required so the root can clamp values, detect completion and emit consistent validation markup before hydration.

onValueComplete.notes: Fires when the code becomes complete (or a complete value is pasted again); runs after onValueChange and immediately before auto-submit. reason: 'input-change' | 'input-paste'.

onValueInvalid.notes: Fires with the attempted raw string when entered text is rejected by validation/normalization.

validationType.notes: Configures the per-slot regexp/pattern/inputMode and the hidden validation input pattern.

normalizeValue.notes: Runs after whitespace + validationType filtering; must be idempotent (it can run multiple times per edit). Result is re-filtered and clamped to length.

mask.notes: Renders slots as type=password; pass type directly to an Input to customize.

autoSubmit.notes: Submits the owning form when the code becomes complete.

autoComplete.notes: Applied to the first slot and the hidden validation input; later slots use 'off'.

inputMode.notes: Overrides the default derived from validationType ('numeric' for numeric, 'text' otherwise).

name/form/disabled/readOnly/required/id.notes: id applies to the first input; later inputs derive ids as {id}-2, {id}-3, ...

dataAttributes: data-complete — all slots filled (Root and Input)
data-filled — value present (Root) / this slot filled (Input)
data-focused — any slot focused (Root) / any input focused (Input)

renderProp.mechanism: render on Root, Input and Separator

controlled.note: Three callbacks: change, complete, invalid — React Aria has no OTP primitive to map onto.

formIntegration.hiddenInput: Root renders a hidden validation input with name, autoComplete, inputMode, minLength=length, maxLength=length and a validationType-derived pattern, plus form wiring.
formIntegration.validation: required is supported; the hidden input carries the pattern so native validation matches the whole code.

keyboard.keys: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move between slots (swapped in RTL), Home/ArrowUp -> first slot, End/ArrowDown -> last (or last-filled) slot, Backspace deletes/clears and moves back, Delete removes the character at the slot; with a boundary modifier Backspace clears from the first slot. All movement calls stopEvent.
keyboard.focus: Focus moves slot-to-slot automatically as characters are entered; slots queue focus while re-rendering.

notableDifferences: No React Aria equivalent (React Aria has no OTP field); migration means replacing a hand-rolled multi-input OTP or a third-party component.
One root + N Input parts pattern: you map over length to render the slots, and optionally wrap subsets in your own layout divs with <OTPField.Separator> between them.
Completion, invalidity and normalization are modelled as separate callbacks/props rather than being inferred from a change handler.
Numeric/alpha/alphanumeric filtering plus an idempotent normalizeValue hook run on every state update.
